subject: IF directive
notes: kb/Work/PB1006 (RETIRED 2026-09-22): the IF frame's TRUE arm emits text-1 and blanks text-2 (the ELSE flips Emitting to ParentActive && !BranchTaken). PB1006 claimed a >>SOURCE line in an omitted branch must switch nothing; 7.2.1 Step 1 says the opposite - 'SOURCE FORMAT directives in the false path shall be processed to correctly interpret input lines' - so the normalizer processing it before conditional compilation is the required behaviour, and the golden pins it (L3).
